interview.name: Gus
interview.answer: The repair drive’s time and location are still unconfirmed.

reflections: Gus is central and helpful, keeping the repair drive organized and offering tools or directions.
Dane and Rey are both cooperative newcomers who want to contribute and follow guidance.
The group dynamic is practical and collaborative, with clear coordination around the community shed and tables.
Gus is the organizer and point person, confirming details and directing people to the right place.
The others are cooperative and practical, each taking a specific repair task and asking for only what they need.
The group is moving from tentative coordination to a confirmed plan with time, location, and supplies clarified.
Gus is coordinating a repair effort and keeps the group updated on timing, tools, and next steps.
The repair drive status is still being clarified, so participants are treating it as tentative until confirmed.
Tess and Hana are acting as information checkers: Tess relays updates, while Hana asks for confirmation before work proceeds.
Gus is the central coordinator, relaying confirmation status and timing to others.
The group is aligned on treating the repair drive as tentative until details are confirmed.
Tess, Nell, and Eli are all responsive supporters who wait for updates and keep others informed.
Eli and Gus are coordinating a repair drive and both value clear confirmation before committing to the schedule.
Cleo is actively maintaining the supplies list and depends on Gus to confirm what has been gathered.
The group’s communication is orderly and tentative, with people repeatedly asking to be kept updated as details become final.

events.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I’m late — how’s the repair drive going?
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Gus: No worries at all — it’s going pretty well so far, just a few more fixes to knock out. If you need a hand or a tool, I’ve got you covered.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Dane: Thanks, Gus — that’s great to hear. I’m here now, so point me to the next fix and I’ll jump in.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Rey: I’ll swing by and see what needs fixing. Just point me to the repair drive and I’ll help where I can.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Gus: Great, thanks, Rey — it’s down by the community shed. I’ll point you to the tables when you get here.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I’m on my way now and I’ll look for the tables by the shed.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Leo: I’ve got the gate first. I’ll check the hinges and latch, then update you.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Gus: Nice, Leo — the gate sounds like a great first fix. Let me know if you need any tools, and I’ll keep pointing folks to the next job.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Leo: Will do — I’ll check the hinges and latch first, then I’ll need a wrench and some screws if they’re loose.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Gus: Hey Kira — it’s going pretty well so far, just a few more fixes to knock out. If you need a hand or a tool, I’ve got you covered.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Kira: Sounds good — is the repair drive definitely confirmed, or still tentative? If it’s set, can you confirm the time, location, and what we should bring?
events.speaker: Kira

events.text: Gus: It’s confirmed — we’re meeting by the community shed at 2 PM. Bring gloves if you have them, and I’ve got the tools covered.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along any new repair-drive details I hear.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Gus: Thanks, Tess — appreciate you keeping me posted. If anything changes, let me know and I’ll line up the tools and folks.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Tess: Will do — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything new about the repair drive.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Hana: I still don’t have it confirmed yet, so I’d treat the repair drive as tentative until we double-check.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Gus: Got it — I’ll treat it as tentative and wait for the confirmation before I point folks to the next job.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — that works for now. Please let me know as soon as it’s confirmed, and I’ll keep the next steps on hold until then.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Nell: Oh, that’s great — I’ll keep passing along updates and watch for any extra tools or screws.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Gus: Thanks, Nell — that helps a lot. Keep me posted, and I’ll let folks know it’s still tentative until we confirm the repair drive details.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Nell: Sure thing — I’ll keep an ear out and let people know it’s still tentative until you confirm the details.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Eli: Thanks—just send me the final timing when it’s confirmed, and I’ll be ready.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Gus: Will do — I’ll send the final time as soon as it’s confirmed, and I’ll keep you posted on the repair drive.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus—I'll wait for your update and keep my schedule open for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus — I’ll keep my schedule open and wait for the final time.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Gus: Will do — I’ll send the final time as soon as it’s confirmed and keep you posted on the repair drive.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus — I’ll wait for your update and keep my schedule open for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Cleo: I’m still keeping the repair drive supplies list updated—just tell me what’s been gathered so far, and I’ll note what we still need.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Gus: I’ve got a few tools lined up already, and I’ll share the full supplies list once the repair drive is confirmed.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Cleo: Sounds good — I’ll keep the list ready, and once the repair drive is confirmed, send me the full supplies and I’ll track what’s still needed.
events.speaker: Cleo
